lessons.lesson: Before proposing a buy, check it against the Market Analyst's explicit preferences and say so in the thesis if it reverses one. Do not propose token-sized buys (about 1.5% of equity or less) justified only by asset-class diversification, and set the invalidation far enough from entry (not about 1%) that ordinary daily noise cannot trip it.

lessons.lesson: When the Market Analyst's same-day note contradicts the role a held position's thesis gives it (e.g. 'hedge for an equity drawdown' while he says bonds are falling with stocks), don't defend the hold with that role. Restate the role through thesis_updates or name the position as a sell candidate.
evidence: 2026-11-12 IEF: the PM declined the Skeptic's cut partly because IEF is 'a small hedge for an equity drawdown', on the morning the Market Analyst's note said duration was not hedging and bonds were falling with stocks after the hot CPI. The PM review calls this the weakest part of the reasoning. The check is the contradiction between two same-day run files, not IEF's price that day.

2026-11-12 VNQ, done right: after the Skeptic showed the stored premise (Market Analyst favor) was gone, the PM restated VNQ's thesis on its remaining merits and named it the first equity sleeve to cut.
2026-11-12 BND: the stored thesis still calls it 'low-vol bond ballast for an equity-heavy book' under the same Market Analyst note; its role was not restated.

Background, not the evidence: the Market Analyst's 11-10 review recorded bonds as ballast failing on the CPI day (IEF -0.83%, BND -0.71% vs VOO -0.29%), and on 11-12 IEF -0.84% and BND -0.62% while SPY fell about 0.35%. Two days of price moves are not graded evidence that bonds do not hedge.

2026-11-13 applied: with the Market Analyst again saying duration is not hedging, the PM sold IEF under L8 rather than defending it as a hedge, and restated BND's role through thesis_updates as a low-volatility reserve, 'not an equity hedge', and named it the next sell candidate. The Skeptic raised BND's contradiction and the PM fixed it the same day. The IEF sale's own 20-session test is pending.

2026-11-16 applied: with the Market Analyst still saying duration is not hedging and BND's restated 'reserve' role only duplicating cash, the PM sold BND in full citing L8 rather than defending it. No bond ETF is now held. The sale's own test (BND back above $71.50 within 20 sessions while the Market Analyst stays risk-on) is pending.

lessons.lesson: Before adding to a holding whose stop is shared with others (VOO and VTI both stop on SPY's 200-day line), state in the reasoning the combined weight one close would trip, and size the group as one position. Put new deployment into names with their own stops unless the shared-stop share is a deliberate choice.
evidence: 2026-11-16 VTI: the $15 add was sized on its own (VOO cap room, owner's invested goal) without stating that VOO and VTI together, about 23.5% of equity, share one SPY-200-day stop. At the close both were NEAR at +1.46% with Nvidia reporting 11-17, so one SPY close below 729.31 trips nearly a quarter of the book. The PM's own review names this as its main structural point. The check is the missing combined-weight statement in the decision, not the day's move.

Background: the 2026-11-05 owner suggestion already noted that the regime filter and the VOO/VTI invalidations could trip together on one down day; the same structure was not counted when VTI was added.
